status: FULL SET (MPFB): 6 adults (m1 m2 m3 f1 f2 f3) and 2 children (c1 c2); every outfit of V5 section 1; LOD0 in people_<v>.glb, LOD1 in people_<v>_lod1.glb.  Bodies from MPFB (MakeHuman, CC0 assets) skinned to OUR skeleton (route A).

skeleton.note: The v3 skeleton (24 bones, the same names and hierarchy) plus face bones under head: jaw (lower face), lids (upper lids: blink), lids_low (lower lids), brow.L/R, mouth.L/R (corners).  Expressions (smile, laugh, frown, surprise) are keyed in the clips.  Joint positions per body (MPFB).  Children use the same skeleton (their own joint positions).

uniform_engineering.look: slate coverall, amber reflective bands (chest, upper sleeves, lower legs), chest and thigh pockets, tool belt with pouches, work boots

uniform_science.look: light slate coverall, blue bands, white knee-length lab coat with blue collar and sleeve bands

uniform_food.look: sage coverall, green bands, white bib apron with ties

uniform_medical.look: pale scrubs coverall, white tunic with red collar and sleeve bands, red bands

uniform_security.look: black coverall, armoured vest with shoulder straps, red bands, duty belt

uniform_command.look: navy coverall, tailored hip-length jacket with a stand collar, shoulder boards with rank bars

prison.look: orange coverall, light grey bands, no pockets used

casual_a.look: jeans / tee: a tee in the person's colour over the waistband, dark cargo trousers, sneakers

casual_b.look: dress / jacket: a knit sweater and wool trousers (men), a shift dress and flats (women); the knit and the dress take the person's colour

casual_c.look: sport wear: a sports tee with jeans and sneakers (men), a tee with soft joggers and sneakers (women)

swimwear.look: modest one-piece (women, girls); swim trunks with a tee (men, boys); the person's colour

school.look: school uniform: a white polo, grey wool trousers and black shoes (boys); a navy pinafore dress and flats (girls)

draw.per_person: Draw Head_<variant> (eyes, brows, lashes, teeth), Hair_<variant> and ONE Outfit_<mesh> (the body skin it leaves visible + its garments) + the outfit's Addon_* list.  Hide every other Outfit_* and Addon_*.  Beyond 12 m draw the same names from people_<v>_lod1.glb (same skeleton and bind; it has no clips: use the LOD0 file's clips).

materials.Skin*: tint like v3 Skin (mode 2); the texture is a detail map around 0.82 that keeps 28 % of the skin hue
materials.Hair*: Hair, Hair_brows, Hair_lashes: tint like v3 Hair (mode 3); alpha MASK (clip 0.5); the texture multiplies
materials.UniformBase*: the outfit's base_rgb (mode 6): the coverall, the jacket body, the rank boards
materials.SuitAccent*: department colour (mode 1): the bands on the coverall and the coat collars and cuffs; accent_rgb in the outfit entry overrides it (prison)
materials.ClothTint*: per-person clothes colour (mode 5); several garments: ClothTint_<garment> (match the prefix)

draw.lod: LOD0 (people_<v>.glb): outfit + add-ons <= 14k triangles; head + hair about 4-6k more.  LOD1 (people_<v>_lod1.glb, beyond 12 m): <= 3k per person including head and hair.

lie_enter_r.note: the right side of a double bed: the head to -Y

sleep_r.note: the right side of a double bed: the head to -Y

lie_exit_r.note: the right side of a double bed: the head to -Y

sleep_turn.note: turns onto the back and back; play it now and then inside sleep

swim_enter.note: a dive from the deck (0.15 m above the water)

swim_exit.note: hands on the edge, push up, a foot on the deck

clips_note: Every clip is baked into every people_<variant>.glb on that variant's rig (heights differ; seats, beds, desks and consoles keep their world heights).  Clip names, frames and pose states are the same in every variant.  New pose state 'stool' (sit_bar_stool).  Pairs: npc_pairs.json.  Vehicle clips stay in the astronaut files (people wear the suit outside).

bench.note: park / pool bench, no back; sit_bench (state sit)

lounger.note: pool lounger: the stand point is beside the lounger at the hips, facing along it (+X to the feet); lounge_pool (state lounger)

bunk.note: jail bunk: sleep_cell (state bunk), the bed layout of lie / sleep lowered 0.10 m

desk.note: academy desk; sit_class (state sit, chair 0.46 m)

board.note: teach: the board 0.80 m ahead, its centre 1.60 m high

arcade_panel.note: upright cabinet control panel: play_arcade (ART-B: please put the panel front edge 0.40 m ahead of the stand point, 0.98 m high)

shelf.note: shop shelf the hand reaches in shop_browse (prop.R carries the item)

treadmill.note: jog: stand point on the belt 0.24 m up (ART-B)

water.note: swim: the origin is the water surface; the body floats face down along +X

textures.note: external PNGs in assets/models/people_tex_shared/ (one file per texture, shared by every variant that uses it); sources in assets/models/people_tex/ (.gdignore)

credits: MakeHuman / MPFB assets: CC0 packs (makehuman_system_assets, skins01, skins02, hair01, shirts01, pants01, suits01, suits02, shoes01, dress01, eyebrows01, eyelashes01).  Motion capture (walk, run): The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.  Details: art/people/people_credits.md

addons.Addon_toolbelt: belt, buckle and three pouches (engineering, security)
addons.Addon_apron: white bib apron with neck straps and ties (food)
addons.Addon_labcoat: white knee-length lab coat, open below the waist; collar and sleeve bands are SuitAccent (science)
addons.Addon_tunic: white hip-length tunic; collar and sleeve bands are SuitAccent (medical)
addons.Addon_jacket: tailored hip-length jacket with a stand collar; body is UniformBase, collar and cuff bands SuitAccent (command)
addons.Addon_rank1: shoulder boards (UniformBase) with 1 gold bar (Rank); fits any uniform, with or without a coat

pose_states.sit: sit_idle frame 0 (chair 0.46 m; sit_bench and sit_class start and end on it)
pose_states.lie: sleep frame 0 (bed 0.55 m); collapse and fall_down end on dead frame 0 (the ground), get_up starts there
pose_states.stool: sit_bar_stool frame 0 (drink_bar starts and ends on it)
pose_states.lounger: lounge_pool frame 0 (no enter / exit clip: fade)
pose_states.bunk: sleep_cell frame 0 (no enter / exit clip: fade)
pose_states.water: swim frame 0 (no enter / exit: fade at the pool edge)
